text:
Noah Kim: hi team, first-day setup Q — on M2, installed Homebrew and asdf, but `python` still points to /usr/bin/python3. followed quickstart. :wave:
DevX Bot: welcome Noah! paste outputs: `which python`, `echo $PATH`, and your shell (`echo $SHELL`).
Noah Kim: which python -> /usr/bin/python3, echo $PATH -> /usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:~/.asdf/shims, echo $SHELL -> /bin/zsh
Priya: PATH order looks off. on arm mac you want /opt/homebrew/bin and ~/.asdf/shims before /usr/bin. add to ~/.zprofile (login shells) or ~/.zshrc: `export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:$HOME/.asdf/shims:$PATH"` and source asdf: `. $(brew --prefix asdf)/libexec/asdf.sh`. restart terminal.
Ben: also check for leftover NVM/pyenv lines that might be earlier in rc files. `grep -E "nvm|pyenv" ~/.z*` is handy.
Noah Kim: moved PATH to ~/.zprofile and restarted. now `which python` -> ~/.asdf/shims/python but python --version -> 3.9.4 (need 3.11 per repo).
Priya: run `asdf plugin-add python` then `asdf install python 3.11.4` then `asdf global python 3.11.4` and `asdf reshim`. If build fails, install openssl/readline: `brew install openssl@3 readline` and set LDFLAGS/CPPFLAGS as needed during build.
Noah Kim: install errored until I set flags. after `export LDFLAGS="-L/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@3/lib"` and `export CPPFLAGS="-I/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@3/include"` the install finished. python now 3.11.4. :thumbsup:
Ben: pro tip: run `asdf install` at repo root — it reads .tool-versions and installs everything in one go. also clone our dotfiles: https://github.com/redwood-inference/dotfiles and run `./setup.sh` to symlink gitconfig and hooks.
Noah Kim: cloned dotfiles and ran setup.sh. direnv blocked .envrc until I signed into 1password CLI; after `op signin --raw` and `direnv allow` everything applied. thanks all! :tada:
